item.title: S1E6: Buh-Bye From Seattle Mayor, Pilots and Bread, Odds and Ends (Things Men Should Never Do, Hormuz Updates, Wackos in OK)
item.description: In this episode, we cover a mixed bag of headlines and commentary—from Seattle’s mayoral politics and the latest aviation stories to the ever-important subject of bread. Then it’s on to Odds and Ends, including things men should never do, the latest developments surrounding the Strait of Hormuz, and some truly bizarre behavior coming out of Oklahoma. Politics, world events, questionable decisions, and plenty of commentary along the way.

item.title: S1E4: Straight of Hormuz; Tiger Woods; Odds and Ends (Things Men Shouldn’t Do, No Kings Protest In UK, Six Ways To Health/Happiness and Easter Eggs at White House)
item.description: In this episode, we cover a wide-ranging mix of current events, culture, sports and everyday life. We take a look at the Strait of Hormuz and why it continues to matter on the world stage, discuss the latest surrounding Tiger Woods, and wrap up with a collection of odds and ends. Topics include things men probably shouldn’t do, the “No Kings” protest in the UK, six practical ways to improve your health and happiness, and the Easter eggs making news at the White House. It’s a little politics, a little sports, a little common sense—and plenty to talk about.

item.title: S1E3: TSA Gets ICE Help; SCOTUS Mail-In Ballots; Odds and Ends (Deployment, Mullen and Delta)
item.description:
In this episode, we break down several stories making headlines across government, politics, and the airline industry. We look at TSA receiving assistance from ICE, the latest Supreme Court developments surrounding mail-in ballots, and a collection of other noteworthy updates—including deployment news, Mullen, and Delta.
A straightforward rundown of what happened, why it matters, and what to watch next.

item.title: S1E2: Iran Conflict, Kristi Noem and DHS, Odds and Ends (Brittany Spears DUI, ChiBears, Lou Holtz)
item.description: In this debut episode, we dive into the rapidly escalating Iran conflict and what it could mean for the United States, global energy markets, and the broader Middle East as tensions rise and military operations intensify. We also unpack the political shake-up at the Department of Homeland Security following the removal of Kristi Noem as DHS Secretary and her reassignment to a new security role tied to the administration’s “Shield of the Americas” initiative, along with the internal drama and policy implications surrounding the move. Then we shift gears with some lighter—but still headline-worthy—odds and ends, including the latest buzz around a Britney Spears DUI incident, a quick look at what’s going on with the Chicago Bears, and a nostalgic discussion about legendary football coach Lou Holtz and his long-running influence on the game.

item.title: S1E1: The 50 Shades of Beer Podcast — Series Introduction
item.description: An energetic introduction to The 50 Shades of Beer Podcast — a show blending current events, political satire, trending topics, technology, media narratives, and unfiltered opinion. This kickoff episode explains the show's premise, tone, recurring segments, and what listeners can expect each week.
